name: Pseudozombie (Raised Man)
body:
PSEUDOZOMBIE (RAISED MAN)
CR 1/3

XP 100
NE Medium undead
Init -1; darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 9, touch 9, flat-footed 9 (-1 Dex)
hp 7 (1d8 + 3)
Fort +0, Ref -1, Will +2
Defensive Abilities DR 5/slashing; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +1 (1d4+1)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 8, Con —, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 10
Feats Toughness
Skills —
Languages —
SQ single actions only, staggered
Combat Gear None (or padded/studded leather)

ABOUT

Created by novice necromancers or experimental reanimation elixirs, Raised Men are crude, unrefined walking corpses. staggered and slow, they crowd dungeon hallways in tight clusters, swinging heavy fists to bludgeon intruders.
